blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A few seconds can capture a moment, but a story needs time to unfold. — MovieRoll Team
blocks.zh: 几秒钟可以抓住一瞬间,但故事需要时间展开. - 电影室

blocks.en: Visual generative models now support realistic video synthesis [ 83 , 82 , 41 , 21 , 67 , 59 , 38 , 62 , 25 , 24 , 50 , 1 ] , synchronized audio-visual generation [ 24 , 36 ] , and increasingly flexible content control [ 20 , 72 , 39 , 79 , 42 ] . However, bidirectional video models jointly denoise the full sequence, delaying the first output and increasing computation as duration grows. Streaming generation instead produces chunks sequentially from previously generated content [ 5 , 71 , 65 , 75 , 56 , 32 , 78 , 28 , 27 ] , enabling continuous output and online interaction.
blocks.zh: 视觉基因模型现在支持现实的视频合成[83,82,41,21,67,59,38,62,25,24,50,1],同步视听生成[24,36],内容控制越来越灵活[20,72,39,79,42]. 然而,双向视频模型共同将全程序列排出,延迟了第一次输出,随着持续时间的延长而增加计算. 相反,流源生成从先前生成的内容中相继产生块[5、71、65、75、56、32、78、28、27],从而能够持续输出和在线互动。

blocks.en: Sustaining quality over long sequences remains challenging. With teacher forcing, models learn from short videos conditioned on ground-truth history. At inference, the shift to self-generated history introduces exposure bias, while longer generation requires extrapolation beyond the training horizon. Growing KV caches further increase memory and computation costs. Self Forcing [ 29 ] addresses exposure bias through self-rollout distillation, and LongLive [ 65 ] extends this approach to long sequences. These approaches primarily target few-step generators, leaving capable multi-step streaming bases less explored. Resampling Forcing [ 23 ] and Helios-Base [ 73 ] address multi-step generation, but the former evaluates durations up to 15s, while the latter uses bidirectional continuation without KV caching. History management introduces further tradeoffs. Sliding windows discard intermediate context [ 29 , 85 , 45 , 65 ] , while retrieval [ 3 ] , evolving memory [ 2 ] , and context compression [ 68 , 9 ] introduce additional mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 维持长期质量仍然是一项挑战。 在老师的逼迫下,模特们从短片中学习,以地面真实历史为条件。 推论,向自产生历史的转变引入了曝光偏差,而更长的一代则需要在训练视野之外进行推断. 日益增长的KV缓存进一步增加了内存和计算成本. Self Forcing [29]通过自滚蒸馏解决暴露偏差,LongLive [65]将这种方法扩展到长序. 这些办法主要针对几步发电机,使有能力的多步电流基地的探索减少。 Resampling Forcing [23]和Helios-Base [73]解决多步生成问题,但前者评价持续时间高达15s,而后者则使用双向续航而不使用KV缓存. 历史管理引入了进一步的权衡. 滑动窗口丢弃中间上下文[29,85,45,65],而检索[3],进化内存[2],上下文压缩[68,9]则引入了额外的机制.

blocks.en: We present MovieRoll , a base-to-distilled framework that builds a multi-step base through streaming fine-tuning and a few-step generator through long self-rollouts. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , MovieRoll supports long-form generation with sequential event prompts. At the base stage, Window-wise Teacher Forcing ( WinTF ) adapts a pretrained bidirectional model using rolling windows [ 52 , 58 , 45 ] . Each window jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention and causal access to preceding clean history. Parallel window training improves long-horizon robustness over chunk-wise training. Hierarchical KV-cache compression ( HieraKV ) retains full history in shallow layers and only sink–recent history in deeper layers. Compared with full-history caching across all layers, it reduces KV-cache memory by up to 78% and peak denoising-step latency with CFG by approximately 53%, while improving generation quality.
blocks.zh: MovieRoll是一个通过流线微调构建多步基, 如图1所示,MovieRoll支持长式生成,并有顺序事件提示. 在基部阶段,Windows-with Teacher Forcing(WintF )采用滚动窗口调整预训双向模式[52,58,45]. 每一扇窗都以渐进式噪声水平排列,双向关注和因果接触之前的清洁历史。 平行的窗口培训比分块培训更能增强长视野的稳健性。 分级的 KV- cache 压缩( HieraKV) 保留了浅层的全部历史, 只在深层保留了沉积的历史 。 与跨越所有层的全史缓存相比,它将KV-cache内存减少高达78%,与CFG的顶峰脱诺步缓存减少约53%,同时提高生成质量.

blocks.en: Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation ( CuLT-DMD ) trains a few-step generator on long self-rollouts under DMD supervision [ 70 , 69 ] . Whereas LongLive-style training updates from individual supervision windows, CuLT-DMD holds parameters fixed throughout each rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update combines supervision across time, keeping one local computation graph at a time and improving long-horizon generation over LongLive-style training.
blocks.zh: 在此基础上,与分布匹配蒸馏(CULT-DMD)的累计长调和在DMD监督下在长自滚上训练几步发电机[70,69]. 虽然LongLive式培训从单个监管窗口更新,但CulT-DMD在每次推出时都持有固定参数,在更新前平均当地梯度。 每一次更新都结合全时监管,一次保留一个本地计算图,比LongLive式训练改进长视距生成.

blocks.en: At inference, threshold-triggered history selection and KV recomputation rebuild the cache from representative generated chunks for both MovieRoll-Base and MovieRoll-Distilled, bounding the retained context and improving extrapolation beyond the training horizon. Classifier-free guidance annealing ( AnnealCFG ) further stabilizes MovieRoll-Base by reducing guidance strength [ 26 ] toward the clean endpoint, limiting late-stage extrapolation before generated chunks become history. The Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill expresses sustained actions and maintains shared entities across event prompts.
blocks.zh: 推断出,阈值触发历史选择和KV重算为MovieRoll-Base和MovieRoll-Distilled重建了代表生成块的缓存,将保留上下文捆绑起来,并改进超出训练视野的外推法。 无级制导的AnnealCFG)进一步稳定了MovieRoll-Base,方法是降低导引强度[26]向清洁端点前进,在生成块成为历史之前限制后期推导. 流媒体快速重写技能表达持续行动,

blocks.en: MovieRoll also provides infrastructure for efficient training and streaming output. Flash Block-wise Causal Attention (FBCA) packs visible keys and values for FlashAttention, accelerating window-parallel training across input shapes. Parallel Streaming VAE (PS-VAE) preserves temporal state across decoded chunks and distributes spatial computation across devices, lowering latency and memory use for incremental decoding.
blocks.zh: MovieRoll公司还为高效培训和流程输出提供基础设施。 Flash Block-wise-Causal Reference(FBCA)为FlashAttention装有可见的密钥和值,加速跨输入形状的窗口平行训练. 平行流式VAE(PS-VAE)在解码块之间保持时态,并在设备之间分配空间计算,降低增量解码的延迟性和内存使用.

blocks.en: On HeliosBench [ 73 ] , MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s. MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods for single-event generation at 10s, 30s, and 60s and multi-event generation at 30s and 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion. A user study further shows majority preference for MovieRoll-Distilled over every evaluated baseline in both settings.
blocks.zh: 在赫利俄斯奔驰 [73],电影 Roll-Base在接受最多15人的视频培训后,仍保持30分的竞争力. 电影 Roll-Distilled在单项活动生成的比较方法中以10,30,60和多项活动生成的30和60,实现了最高的总分,将持续的自然性和主动运动结合起来. 一项用户研究进一步显示,在两种情况下,大多数偏好电影《Distilled》而不是每个评估基线。

blocks.en: In summary, MovieRoll makes four contributions. First, it establishes a robust multi-step streaming base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing and HieraKV. Second, it introduces CuLT-DMD to train a few-step generator by aggregating supervision across long self-rollouts. Third, it supports long-horizon inference through KV recomputation for both models and AnnealCFG for MovieRoll-Base. Finally, it provides FBCA and PS-VAE for efficient training and streaming decoding.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,Movie Roll有4个贡献。 首先,它通过Windows-Windows-Teachers Forcing和HieraKV建立了强大的多步流线基地。 其次,它引入了CulT-DMD,通过集成长期自滚式监督来训练几步发电机. 第三,它通过两种模型的KV重构支持长视距推论,而AnnealCFG支持MovieRoll-Base. 最后,它为FBCA和PS-VAE提供高效的培训和流码.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Bidirectional Video Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 双向视频生成模型

blocks.en: Bidirectional video diffusion jointly denoises a latent sequence, allowing each frame to use both past and future context. Together with spatiotemporal compression and large-scale training, this formulation supports high-quality video synthesis [ 83 , 41 , 67 , 38 , 62 , 59 ] . Joint refinement lets the model coordinate appearance and motion across the clip throughout denoising.
blocks.zh: 双向视频传播会联合暴露一个潜在的序列,使每个帧都能够同时使用过去和未来的上下文. 这种配方与spatioteal压缩和大规模训练一起,支持高质量的视频合成[83,41,67,38,62,59]. 联合改进使模型在整个发音过程中协调整个片段的外观和运动.

blocks.en: Scaling to longer clips increases attention memory and computation. Hybrid linear–softmax attention [ 7 ] and sparse attention in pretrained video transformers [ 63 , 66 ] reduce this cost while retaining joint denoising across the clip. A complementary direction changes the generation order so that completed chunks can be emitted before the entire sequence is available.
blocks.zh: 缩放到较长的剪辑会增加注意力内存和计算. 混合线性-软轴注意 [7] 和预训视频变压器中很少注意 [63,66] 降低这一成本,同时在整个剪辑片段保留联合调音. 一个互补的方向会改变生成顺序,这样就可以在获得整个序列之前释放完成的块.

blocks.en: 2.2 Autoregressive Video Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 自动视频生成模型

blocks.en: To support sequential output, temporal noise schedules separate the denoising progress of different frames. Diffusion Forcing [ 5 ] permits independent noise levels, while SkyReels-V2 [ 6 ] uses non-decreasing schedules. FIFO-Diffusion [ 37 ] applies staggered denoising to a frame queue at inference, while Rolling Forcing [ 45 ] trains a rolling-window generator that jointly refines chunks at ordered noise levels. Robust continuation further benefits from guidance with variable-length history [ 55 ] and training with corrupted history [ 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了支持顺序输出,时间噪声表将不同帧的调试进度分开. 扩散强化[5]允许独立的噪声水平,而SkyReels-V2[6]则使用非减速调度. FIFO-Diffusion [37] 在推论时对帧队列采用交错解析法,而Rolling Forcing [45] 列车则使用一个滚动窗口生成器,在命令的噪音水平上共同精炼块. 强力延续进一步受益于具有可变长度历史的指导[55]和具有腐败历史的培训[73].

blocks.en: Few-step distillation reduces per-chunk latency, as demonstrated by CausVid [ 71 ] , Helios-Distilled [ 73 ] , and Krea-Realtime [ 47 ] . Beyond distribution matching objectives [ 70 , 69 ] , initialization and rollout exposure shape generation quality. Causal Forcing [ 85 ] uses an autoregressive teacher for ODE initialization, while Self Forcing [ 29 ] trains on self-generated histories. For longer rollouts, LongLive [ 65 ] applies DMD supervision to each newly generated clip. Self-Forcing++ [ 13 ] uses a short-video teacher to supervise sampled segments of long self-generated videos. Context Forcing [ 9 ] additionally gives the teacher access to long-range history.
blocks.zh: 很少步骤的蒸馏会降低每吨的空闲度,如CausVid [71],Helios-distilled [73],以及Krea-Realtime [47]. 除了分布匹配目标[70,69],初始化和推出曝光形状生成质量. Causal Forcing [85] 使用自旋式教师进行ODE初始化,而Self Forcing [29]列车则使用自产生历史. 对于较长的推出,LongLive [65] 将DMD监管应用于每个新生成的片段. 自强++ [13] 使用短视频老师来监督长视频自制的样本段. 上下文强制[9]又使老师能够接触长距离历史.

blocks.en: Using longer context also raises the cost of storing and processing history. Temporal pyramids [ 35 ] and coarser tokens for distant frames [ 22 ] reduce the historical token count, while block linear attention accumulates a fixed-size state [ 8 ] . Within KV caches, compression can follow the distinct roles of layers and heads. PyramidKV [ 4 ] varies cache allocation across language-model layers. In video models, head-specific pruning [ 34 ] and calibrated layer–head token merging [ 61 ] adapt compression to attention structure.
blocks.zh: 使用较长的上下文也提高了存储和处理历史的成本. Temperal金字塔 [35] 和远方帧的折合符 [22] 减少历史符号计数,而块线性注意力则累积一个固定大小的状态 [8]. 在KV缓存内,压缩可以跟随层和头的不同角色. PyramidKV [4] 不同语言模型层的缓存分配不同. 在视频模型中,针对头的剪辑[34]和校准的层-头符号合并[61]使压缩适应注意力结构.

blocks.en: 2.3 Interactive Video Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 互动视频生成模式

blocks.en: Beyond sustaining a sequence, interactive generation must respond to changing user input while preserving scene continuity. Applications range from navigable environments [ 48 , 57 ] to camera-controlled video [ 84 ] . For streaming video, history management must therefore account for the active condition as well as memory cost. LongLive [ 65 ] retains recent frames and a persistent sink, refreshing cached KV states under the new prompt at prompt switches. For sink-based histories, LoL [ 14 ] uses multi-head RoPE jitter to reduce repeated returns to sink-frame content. Adaptive memory policies retrieve prompt-relevant history [ 33 ] or learn an evolving memory as frames leave the local window [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了维持一个序列外,互动生成必须响应用户不断变化的输入,同时保持场景连续性. 应用范围从可导航环境[48,57]到相机控制的视频[84]. 因此,对于流媒体,历史管理必须说明活动状况和内存成本。 LongLive [65] 保留了最近的帧和一个持久的汇,在快速开关时将 KV 状态刷新到新的提示下 。 对于基于沉槽的历史,LOL [14] 使用多头 RoPE jitter来减少重复返回沉槽框架内容. 适应性内存政策在帧离开本地窗口时检索即时相关历史[33]或学习不断发展的内存[2].

blocks.en: Meeting interactive latency targets requires both model and system design. On-policy distillation enables fast multimodal avatar generation [ 10 ] , while deadline-aware scheduling reduces delays in live streams [ 19 ] . SANA-Streaming [ 80 ] combines model and system optimization for temporally consistent video editing.
blocks.zh: 实现互动性延迟目标需要模型和系统设计。 政策上蒸馏可以快速生成多模式异形[10],而意识到最后期限的排期可以减少直播流的延迟[19]. SANA-Streaming [80] 结合模式和系统优化,实现时间一致性视频编辑.

blocks.zh: 3 部电影

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of MovieRoll. Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF) trains MovieRoll-Base through parallel window supervision conditioned on clean history and event prompts. After ODE initialization, Cumulative Long Tuning with Distribution Matching Distillation (CuLT-DMD) trains a few-step generator by averaging local gradients across long self-rollouts. Both models jointly denoise a rolling window, use hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) to retain history across layers, and rebuild the cache at a history threshold or prompt switch. Classifier-free guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) gradually reduces guidance during base-model denoising.
blocks.zh: 图2 电影卷总览. 面向窗口的教师强制(WinTF)通过以干净的历史和事件提示为条件的平行窗口监督来培训MovieRoll-Base. 在 ODE 初始化后, 累积长调和分布匹配的 distillation (Cult-DMD) 通过在长期自滚中平均本地梯度来训练几步生成器. 两种模型共同对一个滚动窗口进行嵌入,使用分级的KV-cache压缩(HieraKV)来保留跨层历史,并在历史阈值或即时切换时重建缓存. 无舱制导的无舱制导(AnnealCFG)在基模除鼻过程中逐渐减少制导.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: MovieRoll jointly denoises a rolling window of latent chunks at progressively increasing noise levels. Fully denoised chunks are emitted, and their KV states are cached for subsequent generation. Attention is bidirectional within the active window and causal with respect to fully denoised historical chunks.
blocks.zh: MovieRoll在噪声逐渐增加的情况下 联合发现了一扇潜伏的窗口 完全去诺化块被释放,它们的KV状态被缓存到以后的生成. 注意在活动窗口内是双向的,在完全淡化的历史块方面是因果关系。

blocks.en: As outlined in Fig. 2 , we first adapt a pretrained bidirectional video model into MovieRoll-Base using Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF) . Each training pass supervises multiple windows conditioned on preceding ground-truth chunks and event-specific prompts, enabling MovieRoll-Base to learn transitions across events.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们首先使用Windows-wise Teacher Forcing(WinTF)将预训双向视频模型修改为Movie Roll-Base。 每个培训通行证都对多个窗口进行监督,这些窗口以先前的地面事实块和特定事件提示为条件,使Movie Roll-Base能够学习跨事件的过渡。

blocks.en: We initialize a five-step student using ODE trajectories from MovieRoll-Base, then train it on long self-generated rollouts using Cumulative Long Tuning with DMD (CuLT-DMD) . A frozen bidirectional model provides real-score estimates. CuLT-DMD updates the generator with local gradients accumulated over each rollout.
blocks.zh: 我们开始使用MovieRoll-Base的ODE轨迹, 冷冻双向模型提供真实的分数估计. CULT-DMD 更新生成器,在每次推出时都会累积局部梯度.

blocks.en: At inference, HieraKV stores all available historical KV states in shallow blocks and retains only sink–recent history in deeper blocks. Threshold-triggered KV recomputation periodically rebuilds the historical KV cache from selected fully denoised chunks. AnnealCFG decreases the guidance scale during MovieRoll-Base denoising. The Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill converts user instructions into descriptions of ongoing actions and consistent entities for single-event and multi-event generation.

blocks.en: 3.2 WinTF: Window-wise Teacher Forcing

blocks.en: Figure 3 : WinTF learns rolling generation through parallel supervision of windows with progressive noise levels. Phase offsets expose the model to both short prefill windows and full decoding windows. Within each window, later chunks receive higher noise levels. The attention mask combines bidirectional interactions within a noisy window with access to clean preceding history, while isolating noisy windows from one another. This allows multiple windows to be trained in parallel, each conditioned on its own event prompt and preceding clean history.
blocks.zh: 图3:WinTF通过对具有渐进噪声水平的窗口的平行监管来学习滚动生成. 相位抵消使模型暴露在短的预填窗口和全解码窗口上. 在每一个窗口内,后面的块会得到更高的噪音水平. 关注面罩将吵闹的窗口内的双向互动与接触之前干净的历史相结合,同时将吵闹的窗口相互隔离. 这样可以同时训练多个窗口,每个窗口都以自身事件为条件,即时且在清洁历史之前.

blocks.en: With chunk-wise teacher forcing, denoising each new chunk from pure noise encourages excessive reliance on preceding content, allowing historical errors to accumulate during generation. Rolling Forcing [ 45 ] mitigates this problem through joint denoising within a rolling window, although its training formulation focuses on few-step distillation. PA-VDM [ 64 ] and Rolling Diffusion [ 52 ] also train rolling-window models, but their bidirectional attention couples historical representations to the active window, preventing reuse of historical KV states and limiting access to earlier content as the window advances. Magi-1 [ 58 ] supports KV caching through causal attention across chunks, yet imposes the same constraint within the active window, restricting mutual refinement among neighboring chunks. Building on these designs, WinTF extends rolling-window denoising to base-model training, where bidirectional attention within each window allows neighboring chunks to refine one another and causal access to preceding history preserves context. This attention structure also enables multiple windows to be supervised in parallel under their respective event prompts and clean histories, making training efficient while retaining the temporal consistency of joint denoising.
blocks.zh: 由于老师的强迫,用纯粹的噪音去否定每个新块会鼓励过度依赖先前的内容,使历史错误在一代人的时间里积累起来。 滚动强化[45]通过在滚动窗口内联合调试来缓解这一问题,尽管其培训配方侧重于几步蒸馏. PA-VDM [64]和Rolling Difusion [52] 也训练滚动窗口模型,但他们的双向关注伴侣对活动窗口的历史表现,防止了历史KV状态的重复使用,并随着窗口的推进限制了早期内容的获取. Magi-1[58]通过跨块的因果关注支持KV缓冲,然而在活动窗口中施加同样的制约,限制了相邻块之间的相互完善. 基于这些设计,WinTF将滚动窗口去Noing扩展至基础模型培训,每个窗口内部的双向关注使得邻里块可以相互完善,对之前历史的因果访问保留了上下文. 这种关注结构还使多个窗口能够根据各自事件的提示和干净的历史平行监督,使培训高效,同时保持联合点名的时间一致性。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Layer-dependent attention patterns motivate hierarchical history retention. The first L s L_{s} blocks retain all available historical KV states, while deeper blocks cache only the sink chunk and the most recent historical chunk. The sink anchors visual content, and recent history provides immediate temporal context. Intermediate history remains accessible through the shallow-block outputs, while the active window retains bidirectional attention at every depth.

blocks.en: 3.6 Threshold-Triggered KV Recomputation for Extrapolation
blocks.zh: 3.6 阈值调试KV 外推法的计算

blocks.en: Figure 7 : KV recomputation refreshes historical context for generation beyond the training horizon. Full-history caching expands the context as video length grows, while sliding-window caching retains dependencies on evicted chunks. At the history threshold, recomputation selects sink, intermediate, and recent chunks and causally re-encodes them into a fresh cache. This bounds the retained context and removes cached dependencies on discarded chunks before generation continues.
blocks.zh: 图7 KV重算刷新了训练地平线以外世代的历史背景. 随着视频长度的增长,全史缓存扩大了上下文,而滑窗缓存则保留了对被逐出块的依赖。 在历史阈值中,重算会选择沉淀,中间,以及最近的块,并因果重新编码成新的缓存. 这将限制保留上下文, 在生成前删除已丢弃块的缓存依赖 。

blocks.en: Streaming video models are trained with finite historical contexts but often need to generate beyond that horizon. Retaining all KV states increases memory usage and computational cost while exposing the model to longer contexts than those seen during training. Sliding-window extrapolation limits KV cache growth, but retained KV states may still depend on previously attended chunks that have since been evicted [ 47 ] , as illustrated in Fig. 7 .
blocks.zh: 流动的视频模型受到有限的历史背景培训,但往往需要超出这一范围生成。 保留所有KV状态可以增加内存使用和计算成本,同时使模型比培训期间看到的要长。 滑动窗外推力限制了 KV 缓存增长, 但保留的 KV 状态仍可能依赖于先前处理过的块, 这些块后来被拆迁 [47] , 如图 7所示 。

blocks.en: When history reaches a configured threshold, we retain the sink chunk, representative event-middle chunks, and recent chunks. A causal-attention forward pass re-encodes them in temporal order at t = 0 t=0 , without text conditioning. Generation resumes from this rebuilt cache, bounding storage and removing cached dependencies on discarded chunks. Event-prompt switches also trigger recomputation.
blocks.zh: 当历史达到一个设定的阈值时,我们保留了沉积块,具有代表性的事件中块,以及最近的块。 一个因果-注意前传按时间顺序在 t = 0 t = 0 时重新编码,不设文字条件. 从这个重建缓存中恢复生成, 将存储和删除被丢弃块上的缓存依赖 。 事件即时开关也触发重算.

blocks.en: 3.7 Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill
blocks.zh: 3.7 流媒体快速重写技能

blocks.en: Streaming generation requires sustained actions and consistent entities across prompts. Instructions with natural endpoints, such as a zoom-in, can be difficult to sustain over long sequences.
blocks.zh: 分流生成需要持续的行动和贯穿各种提示的一致实体。 具有自然终点的指令,如缩放式输入,在长序上可能难以维持.

blocks.en: Our Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill expands short user instructions into sustained actions and consistent scene descriptions. For single-event generation, it develops the action within one scene. For multi-event generation, it uses preceding rewritten prompts to maintain continuity. See App. E for details.
blocks.zh: 我们的流线视频快速重写技能将简短的用户指示扩展为持续的行动和一致的场景描述. 对于单一事件生成,它在一个场景内开发动作. 对于多事件生成,它使用之前的重写提示来保持连续性. 详情见附录E。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : The Parallel Streaming Variational Autoencoder (PS-VAE) supports continuous video decoding through temporal caching and spatial parallelism. The upper panel shows how cached decoder states carry temporal context across arriving latent chunks, allowing each chunk to be decoded as it becomes available. The lower panel distributes high-resolution decoding across GPUs through row partitioning and boundary exchange. Together, these designs support streaming output and reduce per-GPU decoding cost.

blocks.en: A streaming denoiser produces latent chunks before the full sequence is available. blocks.en: Temporal caches preserve convolution inputs and track the first-frame rule in temporal upsampling. An initial chunk of L L latent frames produces 4 ​ ( L − 1 ) + 1 4(L-1)+1 pixel frames, while each subsequent chunk produces 4 ​ L 4L . Bottleneck attention is causal across frames and bidirectional within each frame. With full attention history, these states preserve the temporal inputs and visible keys used by full-sequence decoding.
blocks.zh: 时间缓存保存了演化输入,并跟踪时间更新的第一个框架规则。 L 潜伏帧的初始块产生 4 (L− 1) + 1 4(L-1)+1 像素帧,而随后的每个块产生 4 L 4L (英语). Bottleneck的注意是每个帧内跨帧和双向的因果. 随着全注意力的历史,这些状态保存了全序解码所用的时间输入和可见键.

blocks.en: For spatial parallelism, each rank computes the input convolution and middle block on the same latent chunk, then decodes a contiguous row band through the upsampling blocks. Neighboring ranks exchange boundary rows for local convolutions, and an all-gather reconstructs each decoded chunk. This distributes high-resolution computation while preserving single-device streaming decoding under the same cache policy, up to numerical differences. State handling and spatial decomposition are detailed in App. D.2 .
blocks.zh: 对于空间平行主义,每个都计算在同一潜在块上的输入演化和中间块,然后通过上取样块解码一个毗连的行块. 邻居的排名交换 边界行为本地的演化, 一个全加太重建 每一个解码块。 此分配高分辨率的计算,同时保留同一缓存策略下的单设备流码解码,最高为数值差异. 国家处理和空间分解详见App.D.2。

blocks.en: Tab. 2 shows that PS-VAE enables long-video decoding when full-sequence decoding runs out of memory. blocks.zh: Tab. 2显示,当全序解码器内存耗尽时,PS-VAE可以实现长视频解码. 在单一的GPU上,PS-VAE更快,并且比测试的平板方法实现更好的重建质量. 空间平行主义进一步改善了吞吐量,减少了每GPU内存的使用,同时保持了重建质量,并与单GPU输出达成近似数值协议.

blocks.en: MovieRoll-Base is initialized from HunyuanVideo-1.5-480P-T2V [ 62 ] with 6 full-history and 48 sink–recent blocks. During decoding, the rolling window contains five chunks of four latent frames each. During streaming fine-tuning, we perturb clean histories with probability p = 0.9 p=0.9 and noise level σ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.15 ) \sigma\sim\mathcal{U}(0,0.15) . MovieRoll-Distilled undergoes ODE initialization followed by CuLT-DMD on single- and two-event prompts. All stages use Muon [ 44 ] . At inference, MovieRoll-Base uses 50 steps with CFG annealed from 4 to 1, while MovieRoll-Distilled uses five steps without CFG. Both use an Euler solver with a timestep shift of 5 and a KV recomputation threshold of 18 chunks. App. A provides the full configurations.
blocks.zh: MovieRoll-Base由HunyuanVideo-1.5-480P-T2V[62]初始化,拥有6个完整历史和48个沉槽-最近区块. 在解码过程中,滚动窗口包含5块每个4个潜伏框. 在溪流微调过程中,我们用概率p=0.9 p=0.9和噪音水平\\\ U(0,0.15)\sigma\sim\mathcal{U}(0,0.15) 清除历史。 MovieRoll-distilled经过ODE初始化,然后CULT-DMD在单事件和双事件提示上进行。 所有阶段都使用Muon [44]. 推论,MovieRoll-Base使用50步,其中CFG从4到1内充,而MovieRoll-Distilled则使用5步,没有CFG. 两者都使用一个Euler溶解器,时间步移为5,KV重算阈值为18块. 应用。 A提供完整的配置.

blocks.en: We evaluate 200 randomly sampled single-event prompts from MovieGen [ 50 ] and VBench [ 30 , 81 ] category sets. Multi-event evaluation uses 100 MemFlow [ 33 ] prompts. We use our Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill to rewrite all single-event and multi-event evaluation prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们从MovieGen[50]和V Bench[30,81]类中随机抽取200个单项活动的提示。 多事件评价采用100MemFlow [33] 提示. 我们用我们的流视频快速重写技能重写所有单一事件和多事件评价提示。

blocks.en: Video evaluation spans visual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt alignment [ 31 ] . We report all HeliosBench metrics [ 73 ] . The evaluators use CLIP [ 51 ] for aesthetics, Farnebäck optical flow [ 18 ] for dynamics, AMT-S [ 40 ] for motion smoothness, and ViCLIP [ 60 ] for semantic alignment. Naturalness is evaluated with three Gemini-2.5-Pro [ 12 ] queries per video. Multi-event semantic and drifting-semantic scores are averaged across events. App. B details the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 视频评价跨越视觉质量,时间一致性,以及快速对齐[31]. 我们报告Helios Bench的所有度量衡 评审人员使用CLIP[51]进行美学,Farnebäck光学流[18]进行动力学,AMT-S[40]进行运动光滑,VICLIP[60]进行语义对齐. 自然性通过每个视频三个双子座-2.5-Pro[12]查询来评价. 多事件语义学和漂移语义学的分数是跨事件的平均值. App. B详细介绍了评价协议。

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total score at every duration, as shown in Tab. 3 . Its naturalness rating remains stable as video length increases, and its total score declines more gradually than those of Self Forcing and Helios-Distilled. It also exceeds Helios-Base in dynamics and matches or exceeds Helios-Distilled, combining sustained naturalness with active motion. MovieRoll-Base also remains competitive on the 10s and 30s benchmarks, supporting the effectiveness of the streaming fine-tuning and inference strategies used in MovieRoll.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 Movie Roll-Distilled在每个期间都取得了最高的总分,如Tab所示. 3,随着视频长度的增加,其自然性评分仍然保持稳定,其总分比Self Forcing和Helios-Distilled的分数下降得更快. 它还在动力学上超过了Helios-Base,匹配或超过Helios-distilled,结合了持续的自然性和主动运动. MovieRoll-Base在10s和30s的基准上也依然具有竞争力,支持了MovieRoll采用的流线微调和推论策略的有效性.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. MovieRoll maintains coherent subjects and scenes across the three evaluated durations. In the 10s example shown in Fig. 10 , both MovieRoll variants preserve the mermaid and seaside setting, as do LongLive and the Helios variants. At 30s, both MovieRoll variants retain consistent subject appearance and the bar setting, as illustrated in Fig. 11 . LongLive also remains coherent, whereas Helios-Distilled shows increasing color saturation. At 60s, MovieRoll-Distilled preserves the diver and underwater environment with relatively stable colors, whereas LongLive shifts toward close-up views of the wreck and the Helios variants produce darker or more saturated scenes, as shown in Fig. 12 . These comparisons complement the sustained naturalness ratings reported in Tab. 3 .

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total score at both 30s and 60s, outperforming LongLive and both Helios variants, as reported in Tab. 4 . It ranks first in dynamics and drifting naturalness at both durations, while its naturalness rating remains at 10 as the sequence extends from three to six events. Thus, MovieRoll-Distilled sustains active motion and visual naturalness across events.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 Movie Roll-Distilled在30和60秒都取得了最高的总分,如Tab所报道的那样,优于LongLive和Helios两种变体. 4,它在两个期间的动力学和漂移自然性中排名第一,而其自然性评分仍为10,因为序列从3个事件延伸到6个事件. 因此,Movie Roll-Distilled维持了各种事件的主动运动和视觉自然性.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. MovieRoll-Distilled responds to successive event prompts while preserving scene continuity. In the 30s example shown in Fig. 13 , it depicts the transition from sketching a flower to observing a frog and raising a camera, with consistent subject appearance and surroundings. Helios-Base largely continues the sketching action, while Helios-Distilled develops stronger color saturation. In the 60s example shown in Fig. 14 , MovieRoll-Distilled depicts distinct otter actions, from surfacing beside the kayak to handling a rock and approaching the hull, within a consistent lake setting. LongLive shows fewer changes in otter behavior, while both Helios variants largely continue the paddling scene with little visible otter interaction. These examples highlight the ability of MovieRoll-Distilled to combine scene continuity with a clear progression of events over longer durations.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. Movie Roll-Distilled在保持场景连续性的同时对连续的事件提示做出响应. 在图13所显示的30年代的例子中,它描绘了从草图画一朵花到观察一朵青蛙和举起相机的过渡,主题外观和周围环境一致. 赫利俄斯-巴斯基本上继续草图绘制动作,而赫利俄斯-迪斯蒂德则发展出更强的色彩饱和. 在图14中显示的60年代的例子中,Movie Roll-Distilled描绘了明显的水獭行动,从在皮划艇旁冲浪到处理岩石和接近船体,在一致的湖泊环境中. LongLive显示水獭行为的变化较少,而赫利俄斯的两种变体基本延续了横跨的场景,几乎没有明显的水獭相互作用. 这些例子凸显了Movie Roll-Distilled将场景连续性与更长时间内事件的明显进展结合起来的能力.

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Long-Horizon Extrapolation Strategy
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 长视距外推战略

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Ablation of long-horizon extrapolation strategies. All three strategies use the same Stage 1 MovieRoll-Base checkpoint to extend generation from 10s training clips to 30s videos. Full-history and sliding-window caching produce increasingly washed-out backgrounds, whereas KV recomputation preserves clearer subject and street details through the end of the sequence.
blocks.zh: 图16:长距外推战略的缩小。 所有三项战略都使用相同的第一阶段电影Roll-Base检查站,将制作范围从10s培训片段扩大到30s视频。 完整的历史和滑动的窗口缓冲产生越来越多的冲出的背景,而KV重排则通过序列的结尾保留了更清晰的主题和街道细节.

blocks.en: Using the same Stage 1 MovieRoll-Base checkpoint trained on videos of up to 10s, we compare full-history caching, sliding-window caching, and threshold-triggered KV recomputation at 30s. With the local-history policy fixed, the sliding window retains 15 chunks, and recomputation is triggered at the same cache length.
blocks.zh: 使用同样阶段1的MovieRoll-Base检查点,经过10人以下的视频训练,我们比较了全历史的卡车,滑窗卡车,以及30岁时的阈值触发KV重算. 随着本地历史政策的固定,滑动窗口保留了15块,并在同一缓存长度上触发重算.

blocks.en: KV recomputation achieves the highest total score by improving both naturalness and drifting naturalness over full-history and sliding-window caching, as reported in Tab. 5 . With the same model checkpoint, rebuilding the cached context therefore improves generation beyond the training horizon. Consistent with these gains, recomputation preserves clearer subject and street details in the 30s example shown in Fig. 16 , while both alternatives produce increasingly washed-out backgrounds.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: 6.1 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6.1 结论

blocks.en: MovieRoll connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference in a base-to-distilled framework. WinTF establishes a robust multi-step streaming base, and CuLT-DMD builds on it to train a few-step generator through supervision across long self-rollouts. HieraKV and KV recomputation retain historical context efficiently for both models, while AnnealCFG further stabilizes MovieRoll-Base. FBCA and PS-VAE complement these methods with efficient training and streaming decoding. Together, these designs enable competitive 30s generation from MovieRoll-Base despite training on videos of up to 15s. MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total HeliosBench scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
blocks.zh: MovieRoll将流线微调,长滚蒸馏,长视线推论连接在一个基底到底底底的框架中. WinTF建立了一个强大的多步流体基础,CulT-DMD在此基础上通过监督对几步流体的发电机进行跨长段自滚的训练. HieraKV和KV重算为两种模型都有效保留了历史背景,而AnnealCFG则进一步稳定了MovieRoll-Base. FBCA和PS-VAE以高效的培训和流线解码来补充这些方法. 这些设计合在一起,可以使Movie Roll-Base的30s世代具有竞争力,尽管对最多15s的视频进行了培训。 Movie Roll-Distilled在单项和多项评价的比较方法中达到最高总分,最高可达60分,将持续的自然性和主动运动结合起来。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: 7.1 Agentic Streaming Generation
blocks.zh: 7.1 液流生成

blocks.en: In our experience, streaming models approach bidirectional quality in visually constrained settings, such as digital-human animation and game-world scenes with limited visual variation, but struggle with complex motion and camera trajectories. Difficulty maintaining continuity as instructions change may contribute to this gap. Even with a fixed prompt, an unfolding event can leave the next action unspecified. These challenges motivate generation guided by both user intent and the current visual state.
blocks.zh: 在我们的经验中,流线模型在视觉受限的环境下接近双向质量,例如数码人动画和视觉变化有限的游戏世界场景,但与复杂的运动和相机轨迹斗争. 由于指令的改变,很难保持连续性,这可能造成这一差距。 即使有一个固定的提示,一个正在发生的事件也可以留下下一个动作未指明. 这些挑战激励着以用户意图和当前视觉状态为指导的生成。

blocks.en: An agent could provide this guidance by observing newly generated frames and translating user instructions into successive events. It could update the active prompt as the scene develops and plan transitions when new instructions conflict with existing objects or states. Such planning would connect immediate instructions to the generated history while preserving compatible scene content.
blocks.zh: 代理人可以通过观察新生成的框架和将用户指令转换成连续的事件来提供这种指导. 当新指令与现有对象或状态相冲突时,它可以随着场景的发展更新活性提示并计划过渡. 这种规划将立即将指示与生成的历史联系起来,同时保留兼容的场景内容。

blocks.en: The Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill in Sec. 3.7 provides a starting point through its rules for event organization and textual continuity. Visual feedback could extend this process by guiding revisions to the event plan during generation. To support these finer adjustments, window-level captions could complement event-level conditions with supervision for local actions and state changes.
blocks.zh: Sec.3.7中的流视频快速重写技能通过其关于事件组织和文字连续性的规则提供了一个起点。 视觉反馈可扩展这一进程,在生成期间指导对活动计划的修订。 为了支持这些更细微的调整,窗口级字幕可以补充事件级条件,同时对本地行动和状态变化进行监督.

blocks.en: 7.2 Pretraining Foundation Models for Autoregressive Video Generation
blocks.zh: 7.2 自动视频生成预先培训基金会模式

blocks.en: Agentic control also calls for a model that can continue an evolving scene under changing conditions. MovieRoll adapts a pretrained bidirectional video model for streaming generation. Native autoregressive pretraining would align the model with this setting from the outset and allow us to study whether temporal causal attention can match bidirectional visual quality under comparable data and compute budgets.
blocks.zh: 代理控制还需要一种模式,在不断变化的条件下可以继续一个不断变化的场景. 电影 滚滚可以适应预训双向视频模型,用于流体生成. 本地自动回溯性预训将从一开始就使模型与这种设置保持一致,并使我们能够研究时间因果关系在可比数据下是否能够匹配双向视觉质量并计算预算。

blocks.en: This direction could build on language-model infrastructure while retaining bidirectional attention within each active chunk or window. Optimized kernels can skip temporally masked interactions, with savings determined by the chunk or window size and kernel implementation. At inference, KV caching could reuse fully denoised history as the model repeatedly denoises the active video tokens.
blocks.zh: 这一方向可以建立在语言模型基础设施上,同时在每个活动块或窗口内保持双向关注。 优化的内核可以跳过时间遮盖的相互作用,储蓄由块或窗口大小和内核执行决定. 推论一下,KV缓存可以重新使用完全去名的历史,因为模型反复将活动视频的符记去名.

blocks.en: A common conditional interface could then support text-to-video, image-to-video, and continuation with a shared backbone. Adding source videos, masks, and control inputs would extend the same framework to video transformation, inpainting, and controlled generation. Joint pretraining would let us study how data diversity, model capacity, and context length affect quality and transfer. Across these tasks, shared temporal attention rules would connect training to inference, while robustness to self-generated history would remain a learning objective for maintaining continuity over extended video rollouts.
blocks.zh: 然后,一个共同的有条件的接口可以支持文本到视频,图像到视频,并使用共享的主干线继续. 添加源视频、口罩和控制输入,将同样的框架扩大到视频转换、油漆和控制生成。 联合预训将使我们能够研究数据多样性、模型能力和背景长度如何影响质量和转让。 在这些任务中,共同的时间关注规则将把培训与推论联系起来,而与自我创造历史的强健性仍将是一个学习目标,以在扩展视频推出后保持连续性。

blocks.en: Figure 27 : Potential extensions of rolling-window video pretraining. (a) Smaller chunks allow finer noise progression and temporal advances at a fixed frame budget, while loss weighting or regularization could balance learning across noise levels. (b) Total-duration conditioning could guide overall pacing, while duration triggers locate active windows and shot transitions. Together with multi-shot training, these conditions could support coordinated shot sequences under one prompt.
blocks.zh: 图27:滚动窗口视频预训的潜在延伸. (a) 较小块可使噪音在固定框架预算中发展得更细和时间性进步,而减重或正规化可以平衡不同噪音水平的学习。 (b) 时间总调节可指导总体速度,而持续时间则触发活动窗口的位置和射击过渡。 这些条件再加上多发训练,可以支持在一个速率下协调射击序列.

blocks.en: WinTF offers a starting point for this training framework, as its ablation shows better preservation of long-horizon quality than chunk-wise teacher forcing in Tab. 5 . Building on this result, Fig. 27 outlines two connected directions. Rolling-window optimization would address how generation advances through time, while explicit temporal conditions would specify its pace and shot structure.
blocks.zh: WinTF为这个培训框架提供了一个起点,因为它的萎缩表明比Tab中分块式的教师强迫更好地保持长视野的质量。 5. 基于这一结果,图27概述了两个相互关联的方向。 滚动窗口优化将解决一代如何随着时间推移而发展的问题,而明确的时间条件则将具体说明其速度和拍摄结构。

blocks.en: Finer Noise Levels with Smaller Chunks. At a fixed active-frame budget, using more, smaller chunks would allow a denser noise progression and finer temporal advances. The chunk adjacent to clean history could therefore lie closer to the clean endpoint. Greater overlap between consecutive windows could further smooth the transition from clean history to noisy content and improve continuation.
blocks.zh: 细小噪音等级  Chun. 在固定的主动预算范围内,使用更多、较小的块将允许更密集的噪音发展,并缩短时间。 因此,与清洁历史相邻的块可能更接近清洁终点。 连续窗口之间更大的重叠可以进一步平稳地从干净的历史向吵闹的内容过渡,改善延续性.

blocks.en: Regularization for Rolling-Window Losses. Finer noise levels also motivate balancing their contributions to training. Loss weighting or regularization, guided by observed training dynamics, could account for differences in loss scale and optimization progress across the window.
blocks.zh: "滚窗失物"规范化. 更细的噪音水平也促使他们平衡对培训的贡献。 在观察到的培训动态指导下,损失加权或正规化可能考虑到整个窗口损失规模和优化进展的差异。

blocks.en: Duration Conditioning. In bidirectional training, the temporal extent of the full attention window reveals the target duration, allowing the model to adjust motion speed and content planning accordingly. An autoregressive model sees only the available prefix and active window, which do not specify the total training-video length. Without this global duration cue, it tends to generate at the average motion speed learned for each position across training clips. Because text-to-video generation starts without history, it is biased toward the pacing of short clips, making it difficult to learn duration-dependent behavior from mixed-duration data. A total-duration condition would address this ambiguity by pairing each training-window caption with the full video duration. At inference, a target duration, or pseudo-duration, would specify the time budget for motion and event planning.
blocks.zh: 持续时间 。 在双向训练中,全注意力窗口的时间范围揭示了目标持续时间,使模型可以相应调整运动速度和内容规划. 自动递归模型只看到可用的前缀和活动窗口,这些窗口没有指定训练-视频总长度. 如果没有这种全球持续时间提示,它往往会以在培训剪辑中为每个位置所学的平均运动速度产生。 由于文本到视频生成开始没有历史,它偏向于短片的节奏,因此很难从混合期限数据中学习持续时间依赖的行为. 通过将每个培训窗口的字幕与整个视频长度配对,一个全长条件将解决这一模糊性。 推论,目标期限,或伪期限,将规定动议和事件规划的时间预算。

blocks.en: While total duration sets the overall time budget, a duration trigger would specify where the active window starts and ends and when shot transitions occur. These positions would be expressed as fractions of the total video duration. During training, they would come from the sampled window and observed shot boundaries. At inference, they would come from the current window and a specified shot schedule.
blocks.zh: 虽然总持续时间决定了总的时间预算,但持续时间触发点将具体说明活动窗口的起始和结束地点以及何时发生瞬间过渡。 这些立场将作为视频总长度的一小部分表示。 在训练期间,他们将来自抽样窗口,并观察到射击界限。 推论,它们将来自目前的窗口和规定的拍摄时间表。

blocks.en: Multi-Shot Data Training. Multi-shot videos would provide supervision for applying these temporal conditions across changes in viewpoint or scene. A shared caption could describe the shots and their order across windows, while the duration trigger would locate transitions within each window. Training on windows that span shot boundaries would allow us to test whether window-wise denoising preserves within-shot content and follows the requested transition times.
blocks.zh: 多光数据培训. 多镜头录像将监督这些时间条件适用于观点或场景的变化。 一个共享的字幕可以描述镜头及其跨窗口的顺序,而持续时间触发器则会在每个窗口内定位过渡. 跨越射程边界的窗口培训将使我们能够测试视窗解密是否保留射程内的内容并遵循所要求的过渡时间。

blocks.en: Together, these temporal conditions could help the agent in Sec. 7.1 translate event plans into paced sequences and shot transitions. Beyond controlling when events occur, a longer-term goal is to learn how scenes evolve under different actions, including the physical regularities and causal relationships reflected in diverse motions and interactions. Comparing predicted and observed consequences of different actions from the same initial visual state would provide one way to study this capability.
blocks.zh: 这些时间条件加在一起,可以帮助Sec 7.1中的剂将事件计划转化为节奏序列和镜头过渡. 除了控制事件发生时,更长期的目标是了解不同行动下的场景如何演变,包括各种运动和互动所反映的物理规律和因果关系。 比较同一初始视觉状态的不同行动的预测和观察到的后果,将为研究这种能力提供一种方法。

blocks.en: All 54 blocks read clean history from a KV cache. The first 6 blocks attend to all retained historical chunks, while the remaining 48 attend to the first chunk, which serves as an attention sink, and the most recent chunk. Within each layer group, cached chunks and the current window are indexed contiguously from zero, keeping temporal RoPE positions bounded as the video grows.

blocks.en: A.4 Distillation
blocks.zh: A.4 蒸发

blocks.en: For ODE initialization, the Stage 2 base model serves as a 50-step teacher with CFG linearly annealed from 4 to 1. The 5-step student learns to reproduce the clean endpoints of the rolling teacher trajectories, preserving the annealed guidance behavior with fewer sampling steps. After initialization, CuLT-DMD trains the generator on full videos produced with its 5-step schedule. For each predicted window, we prepend the nearest preceding generated latent frames to form a score clip of up to 31 latent frames. If fewer history frames are available, the score clip starts at the video beginning and remains unpadded. Only the current window contributes to the DMD loss. Motivated by the mixed training strategy of Rolling Forcing [ 45 ] , we regularize predictions across noise levels. With probability 0.5, we re-noise the predicted window at a shared timestep and run it through the generator again before computing the local DMD loss.
blocks.zh: 在ODE初始化方面,阶段2的基础模型充当了50步的教师,CFG线性反射从4到1. 5步学生学习复制滚动教师轨迹的清洁端点,以较少的采样步骤保留了厌足指导行为. 初始化后,CulT-DMD在以5步时间表制作的完整视频上对发电机进行培训. 对于每一个预测的窗口,我们预留最接近的前生成的潜伏帧,形成一个最多31个潜伏帧的计分剪辑. 如果可用的历史帧较少,则分数片段从视频开头开始,仍不添加. 只有当前窗口会助长DMD损失. 以混合训练策略为动机, 我们规范了各种噪音的预测。 用概率 0.5 重点预言窗口在共享时间步,再通过生成器运行,然后计算本地的DMD损失.

blocks.en: The LongLive-style baseline adapts the shared-rollout schedule of LongLive [ 65 ] to our architecture. Within a rollout, the generator and critic advance through supervision windows in temporal order, retaining detached history and KV states across parameter updates. Each generator update uses a single supervision window. Each phase contains 600 global steps, with one critic update per step and one generator update every third step, giving 600 critic and 200 generator updates. When a step updates both networks, they use different, consecutive supervision windows and complete both backward passes before either optimizer update. This update schedule is independent of rollout boundaries.
blocks.zh: LongLive风格的基线将LongLive[65]的共享推出时间表与我们的建筑相适应. 在推出过程中,生成者和评论家按时间顺序通过监管窗口推进,保留脱节历史,KV状态跨越参数更新. 每个生成器更新都使用一个单一的监督窗口. 每个阶段包含600个全球步骤,每个步骤有一个评论家更新,一个发电机每第三步更新,给出600个评论家和200个发电机更新. 当一个步骤更新两个网络时,它们使用不同的、连续的监督窗口,并在两个后向通道都完成优化更新之前完成。 此更新时间表独立于推出边界.

blocks.en: CuLT-DMD instead keeps both networks fixed throughout each rollout. The critic accumulates gradients over all K K supervision windows and updates once from their average at the rollout end, completing one global step. On every third global step, the generator also accumulates its DMD gradients across the rollout and updates from their average. The update counts and frequency match the LongLive-style baseline, but each update aggregates K K windows rather than one. We use K = 3 K=3 for 241-frame rollouts and K = 9 K=9 for 721-frame rollouts, as specified in Tab. 11 . All variants use the main inference settings.
blocks.zh: CULT-DMD则在每次推出过程中保持两个网络的固定. 评论家在所有K K 监督窗口上累积梯度,并从其推出端的平均值更新一次,完成一个全局步骤. 在每第三个全球步骤上,生成器还累积其在整个推出过程中的DMD梯度,并从平均值中更新。 更新的计数和频率符合LongLive风格的基线,但每次更新总和是K K窗口而不是一个. 我们使用 K = 3 K = 3来进行241帧的推出,K = 9 K = 9来进行721帧的推出,详见 Tab 11. 所有变体都使用主推论设置.

blocks.en: D.2 PS-VAE State and Spatial Decomposition
blocks.zh: D.2 PS-VAE 状态和空间分解

blocks.en: As described in Sec. 4.2 , PS-VAE combines temporal caching with spatial computation over row bands. Its state contains convolution input suffixes, temporal upsampling phase indicators, and projected bottleneck attention keys and values. Each layer retains its state across chunks of the same video, and all states are reset before decoding a new video. This state is separate from the DiT history managed by HieraKV and threshold-triggered KV recomputation.

blocks.en: We benchmark MovieRoll-Distilled text-to-video generation on a single node with NVIDIA H20 GPUs, as reported in Tab. 7 . Each video contains 1441 frames at 480 × 864 480\times 864 and 24 FPS, corresponding to approximately 60s and 90 rollout chunks. We compare FlashAttention-3 [ 54 ] and SageAttention [ 76 , 74 ] at sequence-parallel degrees of 1, 2, 4, and 8, with FSDP disabled. Streaming Video Prompt Rewriting Skill Description. Rewrites short user inputs into structured,
single-paragraph prompts for streaming (indefinitely extended) video
generation, in single-event and interactive multi-event settings. Goal. Expand a short user input into an objective, detailed
prompt that describes a scene which can be extended chunk by chunk
indefinitely, without reaching a dead end. Modes. • In Single mode, one input sentence → \rightarrow one prompt. • In Sequential (interactive) mode, given the finalized rewrites
of all previous events and one new raw event, rewrite only the new
event. Future events are never visible. • In Batch mode, N N known events → \rightarrow N N prompts,
separated by @@@EVENT_BREAK@@@ . Hard constraints. 1. Camera. Specify exactly one base behavior in a single canonical sentence for
a static camera (“The camera remains static, keeping [subject] centered.”) or a tracking camera (“The camera tracks [subject] , continuously keeping [subject] centered.”). Use tracking when the subject moves through space and
static otherwise. Convert any other movement (pan, zoom, dolly, tilt,
orbit, crane, roll) to the closer of the two. A static camera never
reframes. 2. Centering. The main subject stays at the frame center
throughout. Close-ups only for stationary subjects. 3. Open-ended action. Describe ongoing or repeating motion.
Never use ending words (“finally,” “eventually,” “in the end,”
“at last,” “wraps up”). After the opening beats, switch to
continuity framing (“Throughout,” “Meanwhile”). 4. Natural pace. Real-world speed unless the input specifies
otherwise. Avoid stacked intensifiers. Summarize crowds instead of
animating many small elements. Under a static camera the subject must
still visibly move (breathing, swaying, gesturing). 5. Fidelity. Keep every entity, exact count, event order,
requested style, and on-screen text. Never invent or drop subjects. 6. Style. Default to cinematic realism, also for fantastical
subjects, unless the input names another style. End with a single short
style tag, e.g., “Cinematic photography realistic style.” 7. Format. Output only the prompt as a single paragraph in
the present tense, without self-referential phrases
(e.g., “this video shows”). Use the same language as the input. If the
language is unclear or unsupported, default to English. Keep the output
to 150–300 words, or an equivalent length for languages where word
counts are not directly comparable. Prompt structure. Summary sentence naming all subjects → \rightarrow subject appearance → \rightarrow chronological action
( Initially / Then / Next → \rightarrow Throughout ) → \rightarrow environment, where every
sound has a visible source → \rightarrow restatement of the subject’s fixed
traits → \rightarrow camera sentence, shot size, lighting, mood → \rightarrow style tag. Multi-event consistency. • One camera setup (behavior, viewpoint, angle, shot size) for the
whole sequence. New subjects enter the established frame. Switch between
static and tracking only when an event requires it. • Recurring entities keep identical descriptions. The setting stays
the same unless the input moves it. • Each prompt reintroduces entities without cross-event pronouns, using their
full noun phrase (“It glides toward the diver.” → \rightarrow “The giant manta ray glides toward the diver in the black
wetsuit.”). • Each event continues from the previous state and receives the full
length budget. Validation. Every output is checked automatically for length,
single paragraph, ending words, self-reference, forbidden camera motion,
exactly one camera sentence, and explicit centering under tracking.
Failed outputs are regenerated with the violations appended as feedback,
for up to 3 attempts.

style tag, e.g., “Cinematic photography realistic style.”
blocks.zh:
风格 对电影现实主义的默认,同样对于奇幻主义
主题,除非输入为另一种样式命名。 以单个短片结尾
样式标签,例如“摄影现实风格。 “

blocks.en:
Format. Output only the prompt as a single paragraph in
the present tense, without self-referential phrases
(e.g., “this video shows”). Use the same language as the input. If the
language is unclear or unsupported, default to English. Keep the output
to 150–300 words, or an equivalent length for languages where word
counts are not directly comparable.
blocks.zh:
形式。 只将提示输出为单个段落
现在的紧张,没有自我优惠的短语
(例如,“这段录像”)。 使用与输入相同的语言. 如果
语言不明确或不支持,默认为英语。 保留输出
至 150-300 字,或 等长的文字
计算不具有直接可比性。

blocks.en:
One camera setup (behavior, viewpoint, angle, shot size) for the
whole sequence. New subjects enter the established frame. Switch between
static and tracking only when an event requires it.
blocks.zh:
一个相机设置(行为、视角、角度、镜头大小)
整个序列。 新主体输入既定框架. 切换到
静态和跟踪只有在事件需要时。

blocks.en:
Recurring entities keep identical descriptions. The setting stays
the same unless the input moves it.
blocks.zh:
经常出现的实体保留相同的说明。 设置不变
除非输入移动它。

blocks.en:
Each prompt reintroduces entities without cross-event pronouns, using their
full noun phrase (“It glides toward the diver.” → \rightarrow “The giant manta ray glides toward the diver in the black
wetsuit.”).
blocks.zh:
每个迅速再次引入没有交叉活动代词的实体,使用其
完全的名词句(“它滑向潜水员。” 右转 “巨型芒塔射线滑向着在黑色中潜水的潜水员。
湿服。”)

blocks.en:
Each event continues from the previous state and receives the full
length budget.
blocks.zh:
每一次活动都从前一个州继续,并收到全部
长度预算。
